**Finding: compliant (sits at/above the fallback).**

- **Renewal mechanic** — §13 "TERM OF AGREEMENT" (p0078, rendered inside the §12 block): 1-year initial term, automatic renewal for **successive one-year periods**, exit by **either party** on written notice **30 days** before year-end.
  - Renewal term ≤ 12 months ✔ (preferred)
  - Customer opt-out on ≤ 30 days' notice ✔ (preferred; fallback 60-day window comfortably met)
  - No multi-year auto-renewal and no >90-day window, so no walk-away trigger.
- **Price uplift** — no renewal escalation right anywhere: fees track Exhibits A/B (p0045), §6 freezes Hosting Services costs for the first year and adds a most-favoured-rate undertaking (p0047), and §16 allows amendment only by signed writing. The conditional cap element is therefore not engaged (and any pricing-disclosure/MFN mechanic belongs under MFN, not RENEWAL).
- **Preferred-only shortfalls noted, not redlined:** no Vendor reminder 60 days before renewal and no express "lesser of CPI and 3%" cap. Per the playbook these are minor sub-elements above a satisfied fallback, so no redline was proposed and §13's Client-favourable 30-day exit is left untouched.
